subject: LAB-040
steps: Compile a developer-only XCTest bundle; initialize SKTestSession(contentsOf:) with the original local configuration
Treat StoreKitTest service errors as a failed gate even if XCTest reports its constructor assertion passed

outcome.detail: The final developer-only XCTest bundle compiled and ran one constructor assertion. StoreKitTest nevertheless refused saving the configuration: SKServiceErrorDomain code 2, underlying SKInternalErrorDomain code 4. The driver exited 1. Earlier iterations identified missing XCTest runtime and Swift support search paths; a bare executable aborted. No product purchase was requested.

limitations: A passing constructor assertion is not proof that StoreKit Testing activated this configuration.
The local state simulator is independent and passes its package tests. Application-hosted StoreKit Testing and real storefront transactions remain unrun.
No app target or default scheme links StoreKitTest or enables the configuration.
